aiResearchSummary.text: Chia Network is researching methods for extending a proof of space blockchain and methods for extending a proof of space time blockchain, including grinding resistant consensus in a proof of space based blockchain and pooling in a proof of space based blockchain via singletons. It also develops a method for securing private structured databases within a public blockchain, a method for blockchain gaming based on a state channel, a bridge protocol for interoperable blockchain networks, and consensus layer architecture, covering storage based consensus, interoperability, data privacy, gaming, and scalability.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $61,000,000, or 87.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,749,675 to $500,000,000, a 105.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
